values.note: The township's posted rates: $40 a day for a site with electric, $50 on a holiday weekend; one rate for everyone. Campspot quotes the same $40 for Tuesday, June 8, 2027, plus a $3 fee (site total $43). Rustic no-electric tent sites $28 on Campspot. Cancellation costs $25; under 2 days' notice a night is charged.

fees.source: https://www.claybankstownship.org/claybanks-township-park/camping-at-claybanks-township-park/ ('Campsite (with electric): $40/day', 'Campsite on Holiday Weekend (with electric): $50/day', '$25 cancellation fee') + Campspot site page 55565 for 2027-06-08 ('$40.00 x 1 night', '$3.00', 'Site Total $43.00'), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: https://www.campspot.com/book/claybanks-township-park (all 68 RV sites typed '30/50 amp electric only', amenities 30-Amp, 50-Amp) + township page ('68-site campground (all with electric)'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 68 RV sites, all electric, back-in, on large grassy lots (Campspot allows motorhomes, trailers and fifth-wheels to 50 ft); Campspot also sells 8 rustic no-electric tent sites.

sites.source: https://www.claybankstownship.org/claybanks-township-park/camping-at-claybanks-township-park/ ('a 68-site campground (all with electric) ... large grassy lot') + Campspot (RV Sites 68, Tent Sites 8; site page 55565: equipment Motorhome etc., 'Max Length Allowed 50 ft'), read 2026-10-25

facilities.source: https://www.campspot.com/book/claybanks-township-park (park amenities: Dump Station, Internet Access; site amenity Wi-Fi), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Booked on the township's Campspot page ('MAKE RESERVATIONS ONLINE'). 'Weekend reservations must be for full weekend (2 days)'; holiday weekends the full 3 days.

booking.source: https://www.claybankstownship.org/claybanks-township-park/camping-at-claybanks-township-park/ (rates block and reservation link to campspot.com/book/claybanks-township-park), read 2026-10-25

note: Oceana County township park on a Lake Michigan bluff: grassy sites with fire pit and picnic table, stairs/paths down to the beach, playground, volleyball and horseshoes. Alcohol-free. Operated by Claybanks Township. --Claude
summary: Township page + its Campspot engine: confirmed $40 ($50 holiday; Campspot $40 + $3 for June 2027), 68 sites, May 1 - Sept 18 season, Campspot booking with full-weekend / full-holiday minimums; added 30/50-amp electric only (no water/sewer), RVs to 50 ft, dump, wifi. The note's '42 electric, 26 primitive' is contradicted ('all with electric'; Campspot's 8 tent sites are extra) and was dropped with the redundant season/booking/minimum text. Phone matches.
